service.method:
SELECT DEPT_NAME_LOC AS TEXT , #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT, '000') AS ID , DEPT AS CODE , PARENT_DEPT AS PARENTID , 'DEPT' AS TYPE FROM SDEPT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT <> '0000' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'
AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(PARENT_DEPT, '') = ''
AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(PARENT_DEPT, '') = $S{DEPT}
ORDER BY #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEPT,0)

SELECT USMT.USER_ID , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC , USMT.COMPANY_CODE , USMT.DEPT , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'EN' THEN DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG ELSE DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , 'EMPLOYEE' AS TYPE FROM SUSMT USMT INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT AND USMT.DEL_FLAG = 'N' WHERE USMT.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND USMT.DEPT IS NOT NULL AND USMT.DEPT = $S{DEPT} AND USMT.USER_ID IN ($INS{USER_ID}) ORDER BY USMT.POSITION DESC
SELECT DEPT FROM SDEPT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND DEPT_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + ${KEYWORD} + '%' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT DEPT FROM SUSMT WHERE HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND ( USER_NAME_LOC LIKE '%' + ${KEYWORD} + '%' OR #DB_OWNER#GETCODETEXT('000', 'UX049', POSITION, 'KO') LIKE '%' + ${KEYWORD} + '%' ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N'

SELECT GWML.USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , GWML.LINE_SEQ AS APP_LINE_SEQ , GWML.APP_STAGE , GWML.APP_METHOD , USMT.USER_NAME_LOC AS APP_USER_NAME , USMT.COMPANY_CODE AS SELLER_CODE , USMT.DEPT , CASE ${session.LANGUAGE} WHEN 'EN' THEN DEPT.DEPT_NAME_ENG ELSE DEPT.DEPT_NAME_LOC END AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.POSITION , USMT.EMPLOYEE_NO , 'EMPLOYEE' AS TYPE FROM SGWML GWML INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON GWML.HOUSE_CODE = USMT.HOUSE_CODE AND GWML.COMPANY_CODE = USMT.COMPANY_CODE AND GWML.USER_ID = USMT.USER_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = DEPT.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = DEPT.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.DEPT = DEPT.DEPT WHERE GWML.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND GWML.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND GWML.APP_LINE_CODE = ${APP_LINE_CODE}

INSERT INTO SGWML ( HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , USER_ID , APP_LINE_CODE , APP_TYPE , LINE_SEQ , APP_STAGE , APP_METHOD , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE} , ${session.COMPANY_CODE} , ${APP_USER_ID} , ${APP_LINE_CODE} , ${APP_TYPE} , ${APP_LINE_SEQ} , ${APP_STAGE} , ${APP_METHOD} , ${current.DATE} , ${current.TIME} , ${session.ID } )

SELECT DISTINCT SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT AS DEPT , SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID AS APP_USER_ID , #DB_OWNER#GETUSERNAME(SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, SEAL.COMPANY_CODE, SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS APP_USER_NAME , #DB_OWNER#GETDEPTNAME(SEAL.HOUSE_CODE, SEAL.COMPANY_CODE, SEAL.SEAL_MG_DEPT, ${session.LANGUAGE}) AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.POSITION FROM SSEAL SEAL WITH(NOLOCK) INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = SEAL.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = SEAL.SEAL_MG_USER_ID WHERE SEAL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND SEAL.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND SEAL.SEAL_STATUS IN('C') AND SEAL.MANAGE_NUMBER IN ($INS{MANAGE_NO_LIST})

SELECT USMT.DEPT AS DEPT , BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID AS APP_USER_ID , USMT.user_name_loc AS APP_USER_NAME , DEPT.DEPT_name_loc AS DEPARTMENT_NAME , USMT.position , BALN.ctrl_code , BALN.APP_ORDER FROM SBALN BALN INNER JOIN SUSMT USMT ON USMT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND USMT.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND USMT.USER_ID = BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID INNER JOIN SDEPT DEPT ON DEPT.HOUSE_CODE = BALN.HOUSE_CODE AND DEPT.COMPANY_CODE = BALN.COMPANY_CODE AND DEPT.DEPT = USMT.DEPT WHERE BALN.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = ${session.COMPANY_CODE} AND BALN.CTRL_CODE ='APP_CONFIRM' AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(USMT.DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY BALN.APP_ORDER ASC;
